programme.desc: A troubled young man visited Hidamariya. He says he wants something refreshing and plant-like. Shota suggests a potted lemon tree, but just looking at it won't make his worries go away. So Shota decides to take drastic measures.

programme.desc: 2026 — Minoru Yamamoto, 31, has been making papier-mâché Mount Fuji figures, which he has loved since childhood, for the past eight years. Inspired by Katsushika Hokusai's Thirty-Six Views of Mount Fuji, he says completion is still some way off as he works toward his ideal mountain surface. .

programme.title: Sunday Museum: The Future Seen from Tokyo University of the Arts (日曜美術館 アートの行方 東京藝術大学から見つめる未来)

programme.title: Sunday Museum Art Scene: Exhibition "The Best of the Yamatane Collection I (日曜美術館 アートシーン「ザ・ベスト・オブ・山種コレクションI」展)

programme.title: 76th NHK Cup Shogi Tournament, 2nd Round, Game 15: Takayuki Yamazaki vs. Shin'ichirō Hattori (第76回NHK杯将棋トーナメント2回戦15局山崎隆之九段×服部慎一郎七段)

programme.title: Go Focus: Series — That Game That Touched the Heart: Satoshi Yuki — Kansai Kiin, a Game of Destiny (囲碁フォーカス シリーズ 心打たれたあの一局 結城聡〜関西棋院、運命の一局)

programme.title: 74th NHK Cup Go Tournament, Round 2, Match 14: Yuta Mutsuura 8-dan vs. Yuuichi Hirose 7-dan (74回NHK杯囲碁トーナメント 2回戦14局六浦雄太八段×広瀬優一七段)
programme.desc: A rapid-game Go tournament in which 50 top players compete in a tournament format. This year marks the 74th edition. In the 14th game of the second round, Yuta Matsuura, 8-dan, faces Yuichi Hirose, 7-dan. Commentary by Yohei Shimojima, 8-dan.

programme.title: Nihon no Wazagei: Katsura Bunnosuke, Rakugo (日本の話芸 桂文之助 落語)

programme.title: Laughing Red List 5 (笑うレッドリスト 第5回)
programme.desc: Zetsuken. A facility using the best of science to prevent the extinction of rare animals. Various animals complain to us again today. In the fifth episode, it is the Japanese eel, with the temperament of an Edokko.

programme.title: Shaun the Sheep Movie (映画 ひつじのショーン〜バック・トゥ・ザ・ホーム〜)

programme.title: Aoashi (アニメ アオアシ)

What is the connection between the women walking along the mountain path and this waka poem?

programme.title: Ojarumaru (アニメ おじゃる丸)
programme.desc: Ojarumaru, who came to Moonlight Town from Heiancho a thousand years ago, causes all kinds of cheerful trouble with Kazuma, an elementary school boy, the town’s residents, and the ogres who followed him here.

programme.desc: Japanese language learned through calligraphy (Bi Sen Aoyagi) / 3D paper cutting (Shō Tsuji) / Grouped lazily and sluggishly, kanji card battle, narration (Kenzaburō Tsuda), song “Kokoroyo”.

programme.sub-title: Dripping in the middle of the night

programme.sub-title: Shigeru Mizuki's Yokai Picture Book: Touring the Provinces 4
programme.desc: "Salaryman Yamada" rides a "crow helicopter" and, like a travel show, introduces the yôkai lurking in each region across Japan. This time, the Chubu region.

programme.desc: "Zettai Seiten!!" Performed by P Maru-sama. / "Occhoko Brothers" Performed by SAKANAMON.

programme.desc: Archaeological digs at new sites are under way across North Africa, and are changing what we thought we knew about the Roman Empire. Manga artist Mari Yamazaki visits the sites of the latest discoveries! A journey into ancient mystery full of wonder and romance begins!

programme.title: The Inugami Family, Part 1 (犬神家の一族 前編)
programme.desc: This landmark mystery novel is adapted into a drama in a three-hour, two-part format. A series of mysterious murders unfolds at a lakeside mansion over a huge inheritance. Master detective Kindaichi Kosuke takes action! Based on the original work by Seishi Yokomizo.

programme.title: The Inugami Family, Part 2 (「悪魔の手毬唄 前後編」放送にむけ「犬神家の一族 後編」を放送!)
programme.desc: With the broadcast of "Devil's Temari Song Parts 1 and 2" approaching soon! (November 28 and December 5, Saturday, 9:00 PM, BS) Ahead of that, we re-air "The Inugami Family, Part 2"! Introducing the highlights of both programs!

programme.title: Mitsuaki Iwago's World Cat Walk: Matsumoto (岩合光昭の世界ネコ歩き 松本)
programme.desc: This time we're in Matsumoto. A cat striking a posing pose at Matsumoto Castle. A calico cat and cherry blossoms on Nawate Street. Cats, people, and dogs in the suburbs. Two male cats with a complicated relationship at a soba shop. A cat and a 91-year-old while looking at the Northern Alps.

programme.desc: The "Imperial Theatre," a temple of Japanese theatre with more than 100 years of history, one of the largest in the world! Domoto Koichi, a man who has loved and been loved by the theatre, follows in full detail the dismantling of the huge stage machinery that has supported more than 370 productions.

programme.title: Amazing Earth! Great Nature: The Secret of Striking Landforms — Italy (驚き!地球!グレートネイチャー 圧巻!大地の造形 誕生の秘密 〜イタリア〜)
programme.desc: The Geisler spire in the Alps, the pure white stalactite caves spreading across magnificent spaces, mysterious giant rocks jutting out of the forest... Visit Italy's mysterious scenery and uncover the secret behind the birth of the peninsula shaped like rubber boots!

programme.desc: In Otaru City, Hokkaido, in Ishikari Bay, large flounder over 50 centimeters in winter reach their peak season. The challenger is Mr. Teruei, one of the entertainment world's top anglers. Will he be able to catch a 'zabuton flounder'?

programme.title: Toyotomi Brothers! (44) The Death of a Retainer (豊臣兄弟!(44)ある家臣の死)
programme.desc: To build the Great Buddha in Kyoto, Hideyoshi (Sousuke Ikematsu) has the daimyos across the country provide lumber and laborers, and entrusts Hidenaga (Taiga Nakano) with the task of cutting timber in Kumano, his own domain.

programme.title: [BS Period Drama Selection] Oichi's Strange Tales (3) (【BS時代劇・選】おいち不思議がたり(3))

programme.title: Kyuji-en: Keywords That Make Pro Baseball 100 Times More Fun - Selected: Fence (球辞苑〜プロ野球が100倍楽しくなるキーワードたち〜 選 フェンス)

programme.desc: Could the control tower be shaped like a tea glass? The café is a giant teapot! Everything at Rize-Artvin Airport in Turkey is all about tea! A whirlwind trip enjoying the spectacular views of the Black Sea, delicious tea, and plenty of local fish.

programme.title: Mitsuaki Iwago's World Cat Walk mini: "Cats and World Heritage (岩合光昭の世界ネコ歩きmini「世界遺産とネコ」)
programme.desc: Mitsuaki Iwago photographs cats around the world. The opening feature is "World Heritage Sites and Cats." "Cat Knowledge" is "Cats like tuna." Notable scenes feature cats in Buenos Aires, Argentina, and Ouchijuku, Fukushima Prefecture.

programme.title: Frontiers: Longevity Without Aging — Can Aging Be Overcome? (フロンティア 不老長寿 老いは克服できるのか?)
programme.desc: Is aging a "fate"? We look into the front line of anti-aging research and its challenges, including "plasmapheresis" and "stem cell therapy" aimed at improving dementia and Parkinson's disease, as well as drugs that target aging itself.

programme.title: BS Special: Gifts Entrusted to the World — The Hidden Treasures of the UN (BSスペシャル 世界が託したギフト 知られざる国連の至宝)
programme.desc: At UN Headquarters in New York, more than 240 donated gifts from around the world, including works by Chagall and Dalí, are on display. What hopes and stories are hidden in these precious objects?

programme.title: Fishing Banzai! Hook the Ishikari Bay “Dinner-plate” Flounder — Shoei in Otaru, Hokkaido (釣りびと万歳 石狩湾の“座布団ヒラメ”を釣り上げろ〜照英 北海道・小樽〜)
programme.desc: In Otaru City, Hokkaido, in Ishikari Bay, large flounder over 50 centimeters in winter reach their peak season. The challenger is Mr. Teruei, one of the entertainment world's top anglers. Will he be able to catch a 'zabuton flounder'?

programme.title: Journey of the Heart: Goal! Day 1398, Hokkaido Day 10 (にっぽん縦断 こころ旅 ゴール! 1398日目 北海道10日目)
programme.desc: The 2026 autumn journey begins! Misako Tanaka sets off in search of "scenes of the heart"! From Monday to Thursday, the morning edition and "Goal!" complete one day's journey! Today is the 10th day of the Hokkaido journey!

programme.title: Grand Sumo Tournament (2026) Kyushu Basho, Day 10 (大相撲(2026年) 九州場所 十日目)
programme.desc: *Audio commentary is venue audio. ~Live from Fukuoka International Center~ [Broadcast continues on Sogo TV].

programme.title: Documentary of the World (世界のドキュメンタリー)
programme.sub-title: The Deal of the Superpower (2): Taiwan and Technological Hegemony
programme.desc: Why did the conflict between the US and China intensify to the point that it is called a "new Cold War"? Based on testimony from senior US government officials and Chinese researchers, this second part of a two-episode series depicts the behind-the-scenes struggle between the superpowers.

programme.title: World News ▽America ▽Asia (ワールドニュース ▽アメリカ▽アジア)
programme.desc: ▽ US: ABC, US: PBS NewsHour, South Korea: KBS, Qatar: Al Jazeera, China: CCTV ▽ Weather around the world.

programme.desc: A one-minute look at Tommy and Tuppence, the beloved detective duo from Agatha Christie’s popular series, on NHK BS. Broadcast every Friday from 10:45 p.m.

programme.title: Hard-to-Enter Taverns: Sofia, Bulgaria (世界入りにくい居酒屋 ブルガリア・ソフィア)
programme.desc: Cast: Suzu Yamanouchi, Haruhi Ryōga.

programme.title: The Covers Autumn Fest Premium Edition ~Night 2: Final Chapter~ (The Covers秋フェスプレミアム・エディション〜第2夜・完結編〜)
programme.desc: Lily Franky, Moka Kamishiraishi / Koichi Domoto / From NHK Hall, the concluding part of "Autumn-Soothing Masterpiece Special" / Tortoise Matsumoto "Warereba"; Ayaka Hirahara "Michiteyuku"; Bullet Train "Kanade".

programme.title: Kumokiri Nizaemon 5 (2) (【BS特選時代劇】雲霧仁左衛門5(2))
programme.sub-title: The hidden gold of the Ooku
programme.desc: Kumokiri Nizaemon's (Kiichi Nakai) ultimate goal is the hidden gold of the Ooku. Sae (Saaya Akimoto), sent into the Ooku for the past 10 years, has won the trust of Takiyama (Rie Tomosaka), the Grand Steward of the Ooku, and become her trusted aide.

programme.title: The Devil's Ballad PR (悪魔の手毬唄 PR)
programme.desc: Based on the novel by Seishi Yokomizo. The fifth installment in the NHK Kindaichi Kosuke series. The master detective takes on the mystery of a series of murders that occur according to an old handball song. A gem of a mystery, delivered in two parts, condensed into one minute!

programme.title: Nippon Hyakumeizan Mini 15min (にっぽん百名山ミニ 15min)
programme.sub-title: From autumn to snowy mountains: the Northern Alps and western mountains
programme.desc: Mt. Yarigatake (3180 m) — a dream for alpinists! Sunrise at Mt. Hakusan (2702 m), the sacred peak of Hokuriku! Mt. Ishizuchisan (1982 m), a sacred peak dyed in brocade! On to the steep yet beautiful snowy slopes of Nishihotakadake Dokubetsu (2701 m)!

programme.title: Journey of the Heart: Goal! Day 1398, Hokkaido Day 10 (にっぽん縦断 こころ旅 ゴール! 1398日目 北海道10日目)
programme.desc: The 2026 autumn journey begins! Misako Tanaka sets off in search of "scenes of the heart"! From Monday to Thursday, the morning edition and "Goal!" complete one day's journey! Today is the 10th day of the Hokkaido journey!

programme.title: The Art of Beauty (美の壺)
programme.desc: 2006 — The beauty of cloisonné, with gem-like colors and light born from the pinnacle of craftsmanship. From cloisonné jewelry to the extraordinary techniques of a genius of the Meiji era, and on to contemporary artists who breathe new life into tradition. The endlessly shining universe of cloisonné!

programme.title: Shin Nihon Fudoki (新日本風土記)
programme.desc: 2011 — The Sea of Japan is full of attractions, from food to culture. A selection of gem episodes is re-edited and presented. The hatahata awaited by fishermen, the taste of kombu brought by Kitamae-bune ships, the sounds born of techniques that came from the continent... A journey across the Sea of Japan.

programme.title: Walking the Streets of the World: Kandy, Sacred City of the Indian Ocean — Sri Lanka (世界ふれあい街歩き インド洋の聖地 キャンディ 〜スリランカ〜)
programme.desc: Kandy, in the center of the island nation of Sri Lanka in the Indian Ocean, is the ancient capital of the Kandy Kingdom, which lasted until the 19th century. We meet people who preserve tradition around the Temple of the Tooth, where a tooth of Buddha is enshrined. Narration: Yoji Matsuda.

programme.title: International News 2026: How a Former State Broadcaster Anchor Sees Russia Today (国際報道2026 元国営放送キャスターが向き合うロシアのいま)
programme.desc: Former anchor Zhanna Agalakova, who spent many years reporting in support of the government on Russian state television. What are Agalakova's conflicts over having taken part in propaganda, and what does her future rehabilitation look like?

programme.title: World Documentary: The Two Dereks, the Neighbor Is Rewilding! (世界のドキュメンタリー▽ふたりのデレク お隣さんがリワイルディング!)
programme.desc: Efficient farming or nature restoration? In the English countryside, two neighbors both named "Derek" clash over their opposing views. This uniquely humorous documentary portrays the relationship between the two men, who keep butting heads yet remain oddly likable.

programme.title: BS Special: Silent Cry — What Takeshi Kaikō Saw in the Vietnam War (BSスペシャル「叫ぶ声なく〜開高健が見たベトナム戦争」案内角田光代さん)
programme.desc: Writer Taeko Kono, who covered the Vietnam War, left behind letters that reveal her thoughts. Mitsuyo Kakuta deciphers them and visits Vietnam 50 years after reunification, retracing her footsteps.

programme.title: Japan's Starry Sky: From Spring to Autumn ([4K]ニッポンの星空 春から秋)
Cruising from the Sky: Switzerland, Glacier Express, Toward the Matterhorn ([4K]空からクルージング「スイス 氷河特急 マッターホルンをめざして」 [HDR])
programme.desc: Flying alongside the Glacier Express as it runs through one of the most scenic routes in beautiful Switzerland with a drone. From the sky, we introduce the majestic Alps, spectacular viaducts, and the train and people's lives as they pass through fields and mountain passes.

programme.title: 8K Europe Tram Journey (14) Latvia: Riga ([4K]8Kヨーロッパ トラムの旅(14)「ラトビア・リガ」 [HDR])
programme.desc: A journey on European trams presented in high-definition 8K imagery and immersive 5.1-channel sound. This time, we ride lines 10 and 11 in Riga, the capital of Latvia, one of the Baltic states.

programme.title: [4K] Poem of Life in Images: The Seasons of Yamato - From Autumn to Winter ([4K]命の映像詩 やまとの季節 秋から冬へ)
programme.desc: The transition from autumn to winter, captured by video artist Koichi Hozan, who lives in Nara. A once-in-a-lifetime visual record accompanied by pieces performed by pianist Mine Kawakami. A visual poem that lets you feel the seasons through the harmony of sound and light.

programme.title: [4K] Island Trip in the Sky: Rewinding Time ([4K]空の島旅 時をさかのぼって)
programme.desc: Introducing the spectacular views of tiny islands, mainly from the air. This time, we visit more than 10 islands. We trace events that happened on the islands, going back as far as one with a shrine said to have been founded in 1547.

programme.title: [4K] Strolling Through Images: The Great Adventure of Tara ([4K]映像散歩 タラ号の大冒険)
8K Timelapse Journey: Iwate ([4K]8Kタイムラプス紀行〜岩手〜)
programme.desc: A 8K time-lapse travelogue shot with an 8K digital SLR camera. Enjoy the late-autumn scenery of Tono and the cultural heritage of Hiraizumi in ultra-high-definition images. (Aired in 2020).

programme.title: A Small Journey: A Valley Facing the Alps - Tatsuno Town, Nagano Prefecture ([4K]小さな旅「アルプスを仰ぐ谷 〜長野県 辰野町〜」 [HDR])
programme.desc: Tatsuno Town in Nagano Prefecture, said to be located almost in the center of Japan, is surrounded by the Southern Alps and Central Alps. In a time of population decline, Tetsuya Yamamoto met the people living in Tatsuno in search of spiritual richness.

programme.title: Nature's Wonders - Selected: Osaka, the Reservoirs of Senshū ([4K]さわやか自然百景 選 大阪 泉州のため池)
programme.desc: The Senshu region in southern Osaka Prefecture. Numerous large and small irrigation ponds are scattered across the plains and hills. In early summer, aquatic plants bloom delicate flowers and waterfowl enter their breeding season. Then in autumn, the ponds are bustling with migratory birds.

programme.title: [4K] [Taiga Drama Encore] Taiheiki PR ([4K]【大河ドラマアンコール】太平記 PR)
programme.desc: A taiga drama broadcast in 1991. Starring Hiroyuki Sanada. The life of Ashikaga Takauji, who brought down the Kamakura shogunate, defied the Kenmu government, and became the first shogun of the Muromachi shogunate. A one-minute introduction to the show's appeal.

programme.title: The Beauty of Bihō ([4K]美の壺)
programme.sub-title: Writing the Heart of Japan: Koizumi Yakumo
programme.desc: With the broadcast of "Bakebake," author Koizumi Yakumo is back in the spotlight. From the Japanese landscapes that captivated Yakumo, to the sound of insects he loved, and even the "chirimen-bon" that fused Japanese craftsmanship, we delve into Yakumo's world of beauty!

programme.title: [4K] "Kumogiri Nizaemon" Series PR ([4K]「雲霧仁左衛門」シリーズ PR)
programme.desc: 2013 — Starring Kiichi Nakai. A band of thieves who never kill or wound, appearing like clouds and disappearing like mist. Their leader is Kumokiri Nizaemon. A one-minute introduction to the programme's appeal.

programme.title: Homma-mon (18) ([4K]【連続テレビ小説】ほんまもん(18))
programme.desc: Heroine Konoha Yamanaka grew up in the mountains of Kumano, Wakayama Prefecture. Armed with a natural sense of taste inherited from her father, she enters the world of cooking, where harsh training awaits. A serial TV novel broadcast in 2001.

programme.title: Street Piano, Selected ([4K]街角ピアノ 選)
programme.desc: Florence, Italy. A city adorned with works of art and known as an "open-air museum." The piano is placed at one of its landmarks, the Palazzo Vecchio. What feelings move people to play the piano there?

programme.title: [4K] [Morning Drama] Blossom (31) Week 7 ([4K]【連続テレビ小説】ブラッサム(31)第7週)
programme.desc: Tama (Shizuka Ishibashi), who regains a peaceful life in Sapporo, conveys a "certain wish" to Tamotsu (Daichi Kaneko) while considering how to use the 1,000 yen earned from the Tamomo and Koko Association.

programme.title: [4K] [Morning Drama] Blossom (32) Week 7 ([4K]【連続テレビ小説】ブラッサム(32)第7週)
programme.desc: Tama (Shizuka Ishibashi), faced with harsh reality, tries to stay strong but cannot sort out her feelings. Then Tama finds “a certain article” in the newspaper.

programme.title: [4K] [Morning Drama] Blossom (33) Week 7 ([4K]【連続テレビ小説】ブラッサム(33)第7週)
programme.desc: The novel "Shifun no Kao," written based on her experience of having worked in Tokyo, wins first prize, and Tama (Shizuka Ishibashi) unexpectedly receives a prize of 200 yen...

programme.title: [4K] [Morning Drama] Blossom (34) Week 7 ([4K]【連続テレビ小説】ブラッサム(34)第7週)
programme.desc: Tama (Shizuka Ishibashi) becomes increasingly absorbed in writing novels. Day and night, through the changing seasons, she keeps writing until she completes the novel "Haka o Abaku".

programme.title: [4K] Morning Drama: Blossom (35) Week 7 ([4K]【連続テレビ小説】ブラッサム(35)第7週)
programme.desc: Tama (Shizuka Ishibashi) is troubled that the editorial department has not replied at all to the novel she sent to Kurosaki (Kenichi Endo). Then she brings up a certain matter with Ho (Daichi Kaneko).

programme.title: Still Time to Catch the BS Period Drama ([4K]まだ間に合うBS時代劇)
programme.desc: Set in a row house in Fukagawa, Edo, Oichi (Wakana Aoi) dreams of becoming a doctor and helps her father, the doctor Shoan (Hiroshi Tamaki). A period mystery drama, and the coming-of-age story of Oichi as she aims to become a doctor for women.

programme.desc: 2-minute mini feature of scenic national parks (3) Yoshino-Kumano, Seto Inland Sea, Daisen-Oki.

programme.title: Grand Sumo 2026 Kyushu Tournament, Day 7 ([4K]大相撲(2026年) 九州場所 七日目)
Grand Sumo 2026 Kyushu Tournament, Day 7 ([4K]大相撲(2026年) 九州場所 七日目)

programme.desc: One-loss yokozuna Onosato faces new sekiwake Minoumi, while yokozuna Hoshoryu, with three losses, takes on Yoshinofuji. Sekiwake Atamifuji has defeated one yokozuna and two ozeki, and now faces the in-form Fujiryuga.

programme.title: [4K] Totto-chan’s Treasures, Part 3 ([4K]トットちゃんの宝物 第3弾)
programme.desc: Totoko Tetsuko’s home is full of treasures gifted by stars! Each one is packed with little-known stories. The third installment of touching stories about these treasures begins!

programme.desc: The Lhasa-Nyingchi Railway opened in China and Tibet. Buddhist holy sites, life at elevations above 3,000 meters, and spectacular views of the Himalayas. Introduced for the first time on Japanese television.

programme.title: [4K] "The Chopin Competition: Performances of Genius" PR ([4K]「ショパンコンクール 天才たちの競演」PR)
programme.desc: On BSP4K, from April, every Thursday at 6:00 p.m., we will broadcast "The Chopin Competition: A Gathering of Geniuses." Please enjoy the magnificent performances, including all Japanese participants.

programme.title: [4K] Stunning Views! Touring Europe's Mountain Huts: "Mountain people have lived in these huts" [HDR] ([4K]絶景!ヨーロッパの山小屋めぐり「山岳民族が暮らしてきた山小屋」 [HDR])
programme.desc: Alpens Hut is a mountain hut of the Walser, an Alpine mountain people. It has an atmosphere that makes you feel as if you've time-slipped to the Middle Ages. Many visitors come to the festival where traditional bread is recreated.

programme.title: [4K] Japan's 100 Famous Mountains Mini 15 min ([4K]にっぽん百名山ミニ 15min)
programme.sub-title: From autumn to the snowy mountains: the mountains of eastern Japan
programme.desc: Aizu-Komagatake (2,133 m): golden autumn grass colors! Mount Kumotori in the Okuchichibu (2,017 m): a spectacular view over the city! Mount Adatara (1,709 m): Fukushima’s proud brocade mountain! Mount Utsukushigahara (2,034 m): a magnificent panorama of the Alps!

programme.title: [4K] The Wizard of Oz (4K Version) ([4K]シネマ4K「オズの魔法使 4K版」<字幕スーパー><スタンダード>)
programme.desc: Dorothy, a girl from Kansas, gets lost in the magical land of Oz. A masterpiece musical that shines brilliantly in film history with famous songs like "Over the Rainbow" and vivid colors.

programme.title: [4K] 8K Premium Concert: Sachiko Suda (Viola) ([4K]8Kプレミアムコンサート 須田祥子(ビオラ))
programme.desc: A studio concert by cutting-edge artists. This time, Shoko Suda, principal violist of the Tokyo Philharmonic Orchestra, appears. She performs a powerful solo program!

programme.desc: The time when the sky is dyed in a mysterious color as if under a spell is called the "magic hour." We gaze upon the time wrapped in exquisite colors that appears only in the brief moments between morning and evening, across Japan and around the world.

programme.title: Impressive! Nagaoka Great Fireworks ([4K]大迫力!長岡の大花火 [HDR])
programme.desc: One of Japan's three major fireworks festivals, the Nagaoka Festival Grand Fireworks Display in Niigata Prefecture. This awe-inspiring spectacle of light and sound is presented for a full 60 minutes as filler.

The hatahata awaited by fishermen, the taste of kombu brought by Kitamae-bune ships, the sounds born of techniques that came from the continent... A journey across the Sea of Japan.

programme.desc: Enoshima Electric Railway, affectionately known as Enoden. Linking Kamakura and Fujisawa in Kanagawa Prefecture, its varied scenery seen from the train windows also attracts many foreign tourists.

programme.title: Scenery with the Enoden: A 10-Kilometer Trip from Kamakura to Fujisawa ([4K]江ノ電のある風景 鎌倉から藤沢まで10キロの旅)

programme.title: Honmamon (20) ([4K]【連続テレビ小説】ほんまもん(20))
programme.desc: The heroine, Konoha Yamanaka, was born and raised in the mountains of Kumano, Wakayama Prefecture. Armed with a natural sense of taste inherited from her father, she takes on the world of cooking, where rigorous training awaits. A serial drama aired in 2001.

programme.desc: U-ji Kouji travels to Nishinomiya, Amagasaki and Itami in Hyogo Prefecture. Why are there so many museums in this area? Koshien History Museum, a museum of trick piggy banks, and a museum devoted entirely to skulls. A special feature on astonishing exhibits!

programme.title: Knox Goes Away ([映]殺し屋のプロット)
programme.desc: ★ 6.9/10 · 2024 — An aging hitman rapidly losing his memory takes on a perfect crime in order to save the people he loves within the time he has left. A tense noir about end-of-life choices, with M. Keaton as director, star, and co-producer.

programme.title: YOUNG & FINE ([映]YOUNG&FINE[R15+])
programme.desc: 2025 — A live-action adaptation of the masterpiece coming-of-age manga of the same name by Naoki Yamamoto, a genius in the modern manga world. It tells the erotic yet humorous story of a strange love triangle between a high school boy and a girl who are lovers and a female high school teacher.

programme.title: Other: The Faceless Watcher ([映]OTHER アザー 顔のない監視者)
programme.desc: A thriller starring O. Kurylenko from "007/Quantum of Solace." After her mother’s death, Alice returns to the house where she spent her childhood, only to encounter one eerie phenomenon after another. What will become of Alice……?

programme.title: Inter-floor Noise ([映]層間騒音)
programme.desc: Set in an aging housing complex, this chilling Korean horror depicts the terror of residents troubled by unexplained noises. Lee Sung-bin from Air Murder gives a passionate performance as the protagonist, who has hearing loss and cannot part with her hearing aid.

programme.title: [Film] Night Flower [PG12] ([映]ナイトフラワー[PG12])
programme.desc: Keiko Kitagawa gives a soul-draining performance as a mother who turns to crime for the sake of her beloved children. A human drama of suspense directed by Eiji Uchida. Co-starring Mizuho Morita, Daisuke Sakuma, Ryuta Shibuya, and others.

programme.title: Revolver (2005) [PG-12] ([映]リボルバー(2005) [PG-12])
programme.desc: Starring J. Statham, this buzzworthy film reunites hit-maker L. Besson and director G. Ritchie. A suspense action thriller full of mystery, in which they challenged the world.

programme.title: Death Race [PG-12] ([映]デス・レース [PG-12])
programme.desc: Starring J. Statham. In the near future, in a prison, inmates take part in car races where killing is allowed. A powered-up remake of the cult film Death Race 2000!

programme.title: The Front Line ([映]バトルフロント [PG12])
programme.desc: ★ 7.2/10 · 2011 — A crime action film starring J. Statham, adapted from a screenplay by S. Stallone. A former investigator who has retired from the field is unwillingly drawn into a battle with a criminal organization. Directed by G. Fleder.

programme.title: Wrath of Man ([映]キャッシュトラック)
programme.desc: ★ 7.6/10 · 2021 — A hard-hitting crime action film starring Jason Statham and directed by master filmmaker Guy Ritchie. Packed with gun action, it vividly portrays the deadly battle between a mysterious security guard and criminals targeting an armored truck.

programme.title: The Beekeeper ([映]ビーキーパー [PG12])
programme.desc: ★ 7.3/10 · 2024 — Starring and produced by popular tough-guy star J. Statham, this thrilling action film is packed with energy. Statham plays a “beekeeper” who takes on a ruthless, evil enemy!

programme.title: A Working Man ([映]ワーキングマン [PG12]) (New)
programme.desc: ★ 6.7/10 · 2025 — J. Statham reunites with D. Ayer, director of the hit "The Beekeeper," for another hard-hitting action film. Statham plays a former special forces member turned site foreman who takes on a brutal Russian mafia.

programme.title: [Film] Tatsuki Fujimoto 17-26 Part-1 [R15+] ([映]藤本タツキ17-26 Part-1[R15+]) (New)
programme.desc: An anime collection based on eight short stories drawn by the genius manga artist Tatsuki Fujimoto, creator of Fire Punch and Chainsaw Man, between the ages of 17 and 26. Part 1 includes four works.

programme.title: Tatsuki Fujimoto 17-26 Part-2 ([映]藤本タツキ17-26 Part-2[PG12]) (New)
programme.desc: 2025 — Eight short stories drawn by manga artist Tatsuki Fujimoto, creator of “Chainsaw Man,” from age 17 to 26 are animated by six studios and seven directors. “Part-2” contains the latter four stories..

programme.title: Look Back ([映]ルックバック)
programme.desc: ★ 8.2/10 · 2024 — An anime adaptation of the comic by Tatsuki Fujimoto. A superb work that won the Best Animated Feature Award at the 48th Japan Academy Film Prize. Two girls who met in elementary school draw manga with earnest passion.

programme.title: Hard Romanticker ([映]ハードロマンチッカー[R15+])
programme.desc: 2011 — From Goo Soo-young, director of "My Worst Nightmare", comes this youth violence film based on his debut novel. Set in Shimonoseki, it vividly depicts the destinies of young people living day after day in violence.

programme.title: Nobody 2 ([映]Mr.ノーバディ2 [R15+])
programme.desc: ★ 6.9/10 · 2025 — A sequel to Mr. Nobody, this exhilarating tale follows a middle-aged man who appears ordinary but is a combat specialist. Starring B. Odenkirk from the drama Better Call Saul.

programme.title: Tatsuki Fujimoto 17-26 Part-2 ([映]藤本タツキ17-26 Part-2[PG12]) (New)
programme.desc: 2025 — Eight short stories drawn by manga artist Tatsuki Fujimoto, creator of “Chainsaw Man,” from age 17 to 26 are animated by six studios and seven directors. “Part-2” contains the latter four stories..

programme.title: Copycat ([映]コピーキャット)
programme.desc: ★ 6.5/10 · 1995 — Among the 1990s psycho-thriller boom, when works about abnormal crimes increased, this shocking suspense movie became a smash hit. Starring S. Weaver, H. Hunter and others.

programme.title: [Movie] Big Hit! What Did ME Go to the Amazon For? ([映]大命中!MEは何しにアマゾンへ?)
programme.desc: A unique sports comedy about a former Korean archer who trains indigenous people in South America to become top-class archers. Starring Ryu Seung-ryong from "Extreme Job."

programme.title: [Film] Treasure Island (2025) [PG12] ([映]宝島(2025)[PG12])
programme.desc: Starring Satoshi Tsumabuki, Suzu Hirose, and Masataka Kubota, with director Keishi Otomo of the Rurouni Kenshin series adapting Shunjo Shindo's novel into a major film. A vivid portrait of passionate youth in postwar Okinawa, set against a chaotic backdrop.

programme.title: [Film] Rage [PG12] ([映]怒り[PG12])
programme.desc: Ken Watanabe, Satoshi Tsumabuki and more headline an all-star cast. Director Sang-il Lee of "The Last Dance" turns Shuichi Yoshida's popular novel into a film following "Villain," creating a shocking ensemble mystery drama.

programme.title: MEN: The Men with the Same Face ([映]MEN 同じ顔の男たち [R15+])
programme.desc: Starring J. Buckley from "Hamnet". A woman starts living alone in the countryside. But the men around her all seem to have almost the same face... A suspense horror film by the brilliant director A. Garland.

programme.title: Wild Rose ([映]ワイルド・ローズ [PG12])
programme.desc: 2017 — J. Buckley from 'Hamnet' gives a great performance as a heroine dreaming of success as a country singer. A moving musical drama that received numerous nominations and awards for various film awards, receiving widespread acclaim.

programme.title: The Bride! [PG12] ([映]ザ・ブライド! [PG12])
programme.desc: M. Gyllenhaal, director of "The Lost Daughter," and J. Buckley from "Hamnet." A sensational hot topic that reimagines the horror classic "Bride of Frankenstein" from a modern perspective.

programme.title: [Film] Hamnet ([映]ハムネット) (New)
